verdict.rationale: Mollie Components (Mollie JS) let developers add the credit card fields to their own checkout while staying PCI-DSS SAQ-A compliant. They are documented as an embeddable alternative to Mollie's hosted checkout, alongside a build-your-own-checkout path via the Payments API. Missing for 10: evidence that the components can be customized or styled, coverage beyond card-holder fields (other payment methods), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
